Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam215 contributions

Tasty Bun Bo Hue
May 2018 • Solo
Located in Nguyen Du street, near many tourist destinations and offices, Dong Ba Hue Restaurant has been attracting many tourists, workers from opening to closing. I am not an exception too. As a local, I normally travel here once or twice a week in order to savor the Bun Bo Hue flavor as well as some Hue delicacies. The main reason why is that I do not need to travel to Hue City while I can enjoy the real Bun Bo Hue (the broth is beautiful and you cannot find any places have the “Sate” like here). Strongly recommend it to everyone!

Walked in, no service so walked out
May 2017 • Couples
I was looking forward to coming here for an authentic meal. My partner and I walked in and noticed about 7 staff members, not one even appeared to acknowledge our presence. Th restaurant only had 2 other people in it who appeared to be local. 
 
After waiting a few minutes for someone to take our order/assist us, we were disappointed that we were still not being acknowledged, so we walked out.

I understand that at some places the staff can be rude, and usually as long as I get my food and it's decent I'm happy, however, to not even be acknowledged is totally unacceptable. 

So no food review from me today, but I hope if other travellers try and attend here that they are treated with respect and actually get to have a meal. 

Pure thumbs down for lack of service. 👎🏽👎🏽👎🏽👎🏽
